text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Letting my mind wander during practice isn't good.
I should have focused on what was right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I won't make the same mistake twice.
I'll get right back to training and—”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: Does it still hurt after all...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a lie to say it doesn't hurt...
but compared to the big injury I had when I was a kid, this is nothing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Treat it properly, and you'll be fine.
Now, let's go.
choice_data_list: I want you to rest for now.
...If I decide it's too much, I'm stopping you.
...If I decide it's too much, I'll stop you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Treat it properly, and you'll be fine.
Now, let's go.
choice_data_list: I want you to rest for now.
...If I decide it's too much, I'm stopping you.
...If I decide it's too much, I'll stop you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Still... think about it.
Consider the risk of your rivals pulling ahead in ability."
choice_data_list: What's the risk of leading to a major injury?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I really can't compete with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If she trains with this injury...
it could worsen significantly, risking massive setback... High risk.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I understand that, logically...
My heart just... hasn't caught up, you see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I apologize...
I will stay quiet and calm down here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's totally fine!

...Though it was only first aid, I treated her
and decided to keep an eye on how she did.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The pain has eased considerably. My thanks.
Now then, shall we head to the track?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The affected area feels hot...
But if I just take some painkillers...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: B-But—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That piercing glare of yours
hurts way more than the injury itself...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Understood... I will quietly focus on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mm... No pain when I run.
Looks like I can continue training like this.
choice_data_list: Be careful not to overpace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it's not like the injury has completely healed.
I'll be careful not to make it worse."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You believed in me... and answered my feelings.
Now it's my turn to answer yours.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's start with 10% power.
We'll check how the injury feels as we go!
Even after that, training progressed smoothly, and her recovery from the injury went wonderfully!
